title: AdminTools-MiranoEssentials
description: This plugin add AdminTools to your server
body:
AdminTools (MiranoEssentials)

AdminTools is a comprehensive and lightweight administration plugin for PaperMC 1.21.5, designed for server owners and staff who want full control over their Minecraft server. It provides a wide range of essential tools and commands that simplify player management and improve server moderation.

Features:

- Mute, Kick, Warn, and Freeze players quickly and efficiently.
- Toggle Vanish mode for staff members to monitor the server discreetly.
- StaffChat to communicate privately with other moderators.
- Check command to view detailed player information, including warnings and freeze status.
- Automatic configuration through config.yml for customizable messages, permissions, and settings.
- Adventure-based chat messages with colors and formatting.
- Fully compatible with PaperMC 1.21.5.
- Lightweight and optimized for minimal server performance impact.

AdminTools is perfect for any server that needs professional moderation tools in one central plugin. Developed by Mirano (DJ Mirano).
